sources.title: Qwen-Image-2.1-Text-Encoder-Heretic by Pottokao: Open Model
sources.snippet: Qwen-Image-2.1-Text-Encoder-Heretic is an open-weight model from Pottokao, released under Apache License 2.0. It has 8.8B parameters and a 262,144-token context. At 16-bit it needs about 21 GB of GPU memory, which fits on 1x MI300X from $1.85 an hour, at the lowest prices in the SAVRN Index. It draws 799 downloads a month.

sources.snippet: The patch fixes both errors: the text encoder's [1, 512, 12288], and Unknown model architecture! when a Qwen-Image-2.1 DiT GGUF has no architecture metadata (e.g. unsloth / leejet builds).

sources.title: Qwen-Image-2.1: Compact, Efficient, and Unified Image Creation
sources.snippet: Qwen-Image-2.1 unifies text-to-image generation and image editing in a single model, with just 7B parameters in its visual generation component and native support for generating and editing transparent images.
